scope: Official LangSmith and AWS documentation; account settings and AWS resources were not inspected or changed.

sources.title: LangSmith pricing
sources.finding: Developer currently advertises one seat, $0 per seat per month, and 5,000 included base traces per month. Pricing can change.

sources.title: LangSmith billing
sources.finding: Personal organizations are limited to 5,000 traces monthly without a card; adding a card removes this limit and permits excess charges. Usage limits and trace retention are account settings. Base retention is 14 days; extended retention can cost more.

sources.title: LangSmith service administration
sources.finding: No-payment-method Developer accounts have a 5,000 unique trace monthly limit on a calendar-month UTC boundary. Reaching plan or configured limits can produce HTTP 429.

sources.title: LangSmith cloud regions
sources.finding: SaaS region follows signup location. AWS US uses aws.smith.langchain.com and aws.api.smith.langchain.com; default GCP US uses smith.langchain.com and api.smith.langchain.com. AWS US SaaS runs in LangChain's AWS infrastructure.

sources.title: LangSmith OpenTelemetry tracing
sources.finding: Custom applications can send OTLP spans without adopting LangChain. Batched background export is supported. A base OTLP URL ends in /otel; a per-signal trace URL ends in /otel/v1/traces.

sources.title: ECS Secrets Manager environment injection
sources.finding: Use container secrets name/valueFrom to inject the secret at task startup. Rotations require a fresh task. Secret environment values can be read by container processes and debugging tools. Linux Fargate 1.4.0+ is required if selecting a JSON key or secret version.

sources.title: ECS task execution IAM role
sources.finding: ECS secret injection needs secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the task execution role. Customer-managed KMS encryption can additionally require scoped kms:Decrypt. This is separate from the application task role.
